name: latex-ocr-queen
title: VLM Formula OCR
description: Capture formula screenshots and convert them to LaTeX with VLM providers like Qwen-VL, MiniMax, and OpenAI.
author: licinta

commands.name: ocr-formula
commands.title: VLM Formula OCR
commands.description: Capture a formula screenshot, recognize it with a VLM, and copy LaTeX to the clipboard.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Base URL
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Examples: SiliconFlow https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1, MiniMax https://api.minimax.io/v1, OpenAI https://api.openai.com/v1.

preferences.name: imageSource
preferences.title: Image Source
preferences.description: Choose where the formula screenshot is read from. Finder mode requires Finder to be frontmost with one screenshot file selected.

preferences.name: outputMode
preferences.title: Output
preferences.description: Choose how the copied LaTeX should be wrapped.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Overrides env vars. Env fallback: VLM_OCR_API_TOKEN, SILICONFLOW_API_TOKEN, MINIMAX_API_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_TOKEN, or matching *_API_KEY.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: OpenAI-compatible model name. Examples: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, MiniMax-M3, gpt-4.1-mini.

preferences.name: enable_thinking
preferences.title: Enable Thinking
preferences.label: Enable thinking
preferences.description: Pass enable_thinking to compatible providers. For MiniMax, this maps to thinking adaptive/disabled.

preferences.name: maxTokens
preferences.title: Max Tokens
preferences.description: Maximum completion tokens for OCR output.
